title: 第10章 西边捡来的项西(10)
slug: 格格不入全本免费-格格不入最新章节列表
content_zh:
“我不会再来了，放心，”展宏图啧了一声，“你当这儿是什么美好的地儿啊。”
“来拆了石膏检查了骨折线才能告别这个不美好的地儿，”程博衍瞅了瞅他，“前提还得是你的骨折愈合情况足够美好。”
这个展宏图的腿愈合情况是否美好，程博衍不知道，如果没记错时间，来拆石膏的日子已经过了，他没再来过。
再有两天就过年了，街上满眼都是各种红色，还有老刘那首百年播不停，再播一百年可能也不会停的过年专用歌。
我恭喜你发财，我恭喜你精彩，最好的请过来，不好的请走开……
为了防止陷入无止境的单曲循环，程博衍从超市出来的时候就迅速清空了脑海里的旋律，默默唱了一遍国歌。
结果回到车里，刚一Oh，礼多人不怪，我祝满天下的女孩，嫁一个好男孩，两小口永远在一块……
程博衍条件反射地跟着哼了两句之后赶紧换了个台，不过已经晚了，这歌太熟，换不换都没意义了，听个开头就能一路勇往直前永不停息。
一边听着新歌速递都还能在脑子里唱着恭喜发财。
今天他要去趟奶奶家，车里有一堆老妈买了让他送过去的东西。
每年他们差不多都会去奶奶家过年，老妈的营养年货和奶奶的吃货年货拉锯大战从上周就开始了，会一直持续到正月结束。
他就是个负责采购和运输的力巴。
车开到半路，奶奶打了电话过来问他什么时候到：“你吃过晚饭了？要不要再给你做点儿吃的？你是不是天天就吃豆啊？”
“别做了，我今天吃的不是豆，有肉，”程博衍笑着说，“我一会儿就到了，刚从超市出来。”
挂了奶奶的电话，程博衍把耳机拿下来扔到一边。
就在扔耳机的一瞬间，路边突然冲出来一个人影，没等他看清，就已经到了车跟前。
程博衍赶紧一脚把刹车踩到底，车发出一声尖叫，距离那人大概也就二十公分时停下了。
“过街先看看车啊！怎么突然冲出来？”程博衍放下车窗喊了一声，“撞上了怎么办！”
看到那人虽然像是吓了一跳地下意识举着胳膊挡了一下，但还是站着的，他松了口气，想等那人走开之后继续往前开。
但意料之外的一幕就这么没有征兆地出现了。

那人在一秒钟之后突然倒在了地上。
程博衍愣了能有三秒才反应过来。
首先他清楚自己肯定没有碰到这人，那么这人不可能是因为被撞了而倒地，接着根据自己的经验，要是被吓晕了，也不是这个状态，倒地了还能遮着灯光往上探脑袋的。
所以……
有生之年啊！
有生之年居然能遭遇一次碰瓷！
“您继续。”程博衍说了一句，按下了车前行车记录仪的保存键，把之前的记录锁定了。
话刚说完，那人从地上坐了起来，手遮着车灯打在他脸上的光往驾驶室里瞅：“大哥听声音耳熟啊。”
“你……”程博衍往他脸上扫了一眼，差点儿没咬着自己的舌头，“展宏图？”
项西今天点儿背，出来转悠一圈没弄着什么好东西，还碰上了死对头。
不是他的死对头，是平叔的。
按项西的标准，平叔其实混得不算成功，也就流氓混混界里刚脱离了温饱的那款，这辈子要没被逮，没被人打死，也就窝在大洼里喝茶、打牌、收租，带使唤手底下这帮更没用的小弟了。
但就算是这样的人，也还是会有仇家的，毕竟混得好混得不好都是在混。
像项西这种跟在平叔身边长大的人，在仇家眼里，面熟的程度跟平叔一个级别。
马上就过年了，他被人拿着棍追了三条街。两分钟前刚甩掉人，跑到了跟馒头和大健他们约好的地方，可偏偏这二位说好的九点却没准时到。
这还在别人的地盘上，追兵们肯定不会空手回，为了保证自己在馒头他们过来之前的安全，他打算找辆车碰一下，制造点儿混乱，让对方不方便动手。
但他真没想到就这么一下居然能碰上程博衍的车。

content_en:
"I won't come again, don't worry," Zhan Hongtu clicked his tongue, "Do you think this is a beautiful place?"
"I came to remove the plaster and check the fracture line before we can say goodbye to this unhappy place." Cheng Boyan looked at him, "The prerequisite is that your fracture healing is good enough."
Cheng Boyan didn't know whether Zhan Hongtu's leg was healing well. If he remembered the time correctly, the day to remove the plaster had already passed and he never came again.
The Chinese New Year will be here in two days, and the streets are filled with all kinds of reds, as well as Lao Liu’s special New Year song that has been playing for a hundred years and will probably not stop playing for another hundred years.
I congratulate you on getting rich, I congratulate you on being wonderful, please come if you are the best, please go away if you are not good...
In order to avoid falling into an endless cycle of singles, Cheng Boyan quickly cleared the melody in his mind when he came out of the supermarket and sang the national anthem silently.
Finally, when I got back to the car, I just said Oh. It’s not surprising that there are so many people saying goodbye. I wish all the girls in the world to marry a good boy and we will be together forever...
Cheng Boyan reflexively hummed a few lines and quickly changed the channel, but it was too late. The song was so familiar that it was meaningless to change it. Listening to the beginning would make him move forward bravely and never stop.
While listening to the new song Express, I can still sing Gong Xi Fa Cai in my head.
Today he was going to his grandma's house, and there were a bunch of things in the car that his mother had bought for him to send over.
Almost every year, they go to grandma’s house to celebrate the New Year. The tug-of-war between mom’s nutritious New Year’s goods and grandma’s foodie New Year’s goods started last week and will continue until the end of the first month.
He is the man in charge of purchasing and shipping.
Halfway through the car, grandma called and asked him when he would arrive: "Have you had dinner? Do you want to cook you something more? Do you eat beans every day?"
"Don't do it. What I ate today is not beans, but meat," Cheng Boyan said with a smile, "I'll be there in a moment, I just came out of the supermarket."
After hanging up the phone with grandma, Cheng Boyan took off the earphones and threw them aside.
The moment he threw the earphones, a figure suddenly rushed out from the roadside. Before he could see clearly, he was already in front of the car.
Cheng Boyan quickly pressed the brakes to the bottom. The car screamed and stopped about twenty centimeters away from the man.
"Look at the car before you cross the street! Why did you rush out suddenly?" Cheng Boyan put down the car window and shouted, "What should I do if I hit it!"
Seeing that the man was still standing even though he subconsciously raised his arms to block him as if he was startled, he breathed a sigh of relief and wanted to wait for the man to walk away and continue driving forward.
But an unexpected scene happened without warning.
The man suddenly fell to the ground a second later.
Cheng Boyan was stunned for three seconds before he reacted.
First of all, he knew that he had definitely not touched this person, so this person could not have fallen to the ground because of being hit. Then based on his own experience, if he was stunned, it would not be in this state. After he fell to the ground, he could still look up with his head covered by the light.
So...
In my lifetime!
You can actually encounter a collision in your lifetime!
"You continue." Cheng Boyan said, and pressed the save button on the driving recorder in front of the car, locking the previous record.
As soon as he finished speaking, the man sat up from the ground, covering his face with the light of the car lights and looking into the cab: "Brother, the voice sounds familiar."
"You..." Cheng Boyan glanced at his face and almost bit his tongue, "Zhan Hongtu?"
Xiang west was a bit lazy today. He went out for a walk and didn't get anything good, and he also met his sworn enemy.
It's not his mortal enemy, it's Uncle Ping's.
According to Xiang Xi's standards, Uncle Ping's career was actually not a success. He was just one of the gangsters who had just escaped from food and clothing. Unless he was caught or beaten to death in his life, he would just sit in a big puddle drinking tea, playing cards, collecting rent, and bossing around his gang of even more useless men.But even for such a person, there will still be enemies. After all, whether you are getting along well or not, you are just getting along.
People like Xiang west who grew up with Uncle Ping, in the eyes of their enemies, are as familiar as Uncle Ping.
The Chinese New Year was coming soon, and he was chased through three streets with a stick. I just dumped someone two minutes ago and ran to the place I had made an appointment with Mantou and Dajian. However, the two of them didn't arrive on time at nine o'clock as promised.
This was still on someone else's territory, and the pursuers would definitely not return empty-handed. In order to ensure his safety before Mantou and the others came over, he planned to find a car to bump into, creating some chaos and making it inconvenient for the other party to attack.
But he really didn't expect to run into Cheng Boyan's car just like that.
